subject: Geopolitics
title: Alliances in the Age of AI
description: A micro-lesson that makes Alliances in the Age of AI usable.

hook.text: An AI decides in milliseconds whether a drone strikes. If allies use different AI systems, coordination collapses.

buildup.text: AI is transforming warfare: autonomous weapons, cyber defense, and predictive intelligence change what alliances need.

discovery.text: Interoperability now means data and algorithms, not just guns and radios. Allied AI systems must talk to each other.

twist.text: Sharing AI means sharing data — and many allies don't trust each other enough for that level of transparency.

climax.text: AI may split alliances into tiers: inner circles that share data and outer rings that don't. Trust becomes code.

punchline.text: The alliance of the future runs on algorithms, not handshakes.

quiz.question: What challenge does AI pose for military alliances?
options: Allied AI systems must be interoperable, requiring deep data sharing
AI weapons are banned by international law
